Properties:
  .aliases: "['RE']"
  .description: "IUCN conservation category"
  .name: "Regionally Extinct"

Node Type: Habitat
Properties:
  .aliases: "['grasslands', 'natural meadow']"
  .description: "area with vegetation dominated by grasses"
  .name: "grassland"

Node Type: Taxon
Properties:
  .aliases: "[]"
  .description: "family of weevils"
  .diel_cycle: "diurnality"
  .longest_lifespan_years: "208.0"
  .name: "Brentidae"
  .taxon_name: "Brentidae"

Node Type: TaxonRank
Properties:
  .aliases: "['supersubtrib.']"
  .description: "taxonomic rank"
  .name: "supersubtribe"

# Relationship types and their valid endpoint patterns
Type: hasRank
  - (:Taxon)-[:hasRank]->(:TaxonRank)

Type: hasParent
  - (:Taxon)-[:hasParent]->(:Taxon)

Type: hasConservationStatus
  - (:Taxon)-[:hasConservationStatus]->(:ConservationStatus)

Type: inhabits
  - (:Taxon)-[:inhabits]->(:Habitat)
